reference_summary: A genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 knockout screen in four KRAS-mutant pancreatic cancer cell lines identified SHP2 and SOS1 as selective dependencies; SHP2 knockout reduced viability by 70% (p < 0.01), nominating the SHP2-SOS1 axis as a therapeutic target.
